title: Tree Coloring
statementMd:
You are given a rooted tree consisting of $n$ vertices numbered from $1$ to $n$. The root of the tree is the vertex $1$.

You have to color all vertices of the tree into $n$ colors (also numbered from $1$ to $n$) so that there is exactly one vertex for each color. Let $c_i$ be the color of vertex $i$, and $p_i$ be the parent of vertex $i$ in the rooted tree. The coloring is considered beautiful if there is no vertex $k$ ($k \gt 1$) such that $c_k = c_{p_k} - 1$, i. e. no vertex such that its color is less than the color of its parent by **exactly $1$**.

Calculate the number of beautiful colorings, and print it modulo $998244353$.

## Input

The first line contains one integer $n$ ($2 \le n \le 250000$) — the number of vertices in the tree.

Then $n-1$ lines follow, the $i$-th line contains two integers $x_i$ and $y_i$ ($1 \le x_i, y_i \le n$; $x_i \ne y_i$) denoting an edge between the vertex $x_i$ and the vertex $y_i$. These edges form a tree.

## Output

Print one integer — the number of beautiful colorings, taken modulo $998244353$.
statementZhMd:
给定一棵包含 $n$ 个顶点的有根树，顶点编号为 $1$ 至 $n$。该树的根节点为顶点 $1$。

你需要使用 $n$ 种颜色为树中的所有顶点染色，颜色编号同样为 $1$ 至 $n$，并且每种颜色恰好分配给一个顶点。令 $c_i$ 表示顶点 $i$ 的颜色，$p_i$ 表示顶点 $i$ 在这棵有根树中的父节点。如果不存在顶点 $k$（$k \gt 1$）满足 $c_k = c_{p_k} - 1$，则称该染色方案是美丽的；也就是说，不存在其颜色比父节点的颜色小 **$1$** 的顶点。

请计算美丽染色方案的数量，并将结果对 $998244353$ 取模后输出。

## 输入

第一行包含一个整数 $n$（$2 \le n \le 250000$），表示树中顶点的数量。

接下来 $n-1$ 行，第 $i$ 行包含两个整数 $x_i$ 和 $y_i$（$1 \le x_i, y_i \le n$；$x_i \ne y_i$），表示顶点 $x_i$ 和顶点 $y_i$ 之间存在一条边。这些边构成一棵树。

## 输出

输出一个整数，即美丽染色方案的数量对 $998244353$ 取模后的结果。
